snippet.title: EVERGUEST: The Veiled Inn - Gameplay Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Three heroes. A mysterious inn. And a magical mist that won't let them escape.

EVERGUEST: The Veiled Inn is a dark fantasy turn-based roguelite RPG where every journey beyond the inn leads into a dangerous world filled with monsters, undead enemies, eerie events and tactical battles.

Lead your party of three heroes and master the Overflow system, generating temporary Mana through basic actions to unleash powerful skills. Customize your abilities with mods, build powerful relic synergies and manage your resources carefully as you adapt your strategy from run to run.

But turn-based doesn't mean you can sit back. An active timing system lets you dodge enemy attacks in real time, putting your reflexes to the test even in the middle of tactical combat.

Venture deeper into the mist, survive its nightmares and uncover the secrets of the Veiled Inn.

Wishlist EVERGUEST: The Veiled Inn now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4662550/Everguest_The_Veiled_Inn/
